spec_family.name: New Construction Interior Trim Finish Coat
spec_family.description: Finish coat painting for 9 interior trim types in new construction. Covers post-primer initial prep (light touch-up), finish coat application (brush or spray), interstage between-coat process, and final inspection. Finish-only spec (Scenario B per Fine Finish Doctrine Section 5.2) — primer handled by companion SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME. Uses LF as primary UOM (1 LF = 1 SF per PCA standard for trim <1 ft width). Material systems are quality-tier-driven recommendations — contractor retains discretion on product selection.

includes: Shadow box / picture frame molding finish painting
Post-primer initial prep (light touch-up: inspect, light sand, touch-up caulk, dust cleanup)
Between-coat interstage process (inspect, sand, repair, clean) at ALL quality tiers
Wall masking at trim-to-wall edge (spray or when walls are SS_PAINTED_*)
2 finish coats standard; 3+ coats at QT5 brush/roll per FFD 15.10.3

excludes.item: Primer coat (fill, heavy caulk, heavy sand, prime application)
Masking off finished trim for subsequent wall painting

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection scrutiny, sanding discipline, repair scope, and coat count. Does NOT affect application quality (binary at all tiers).
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard production. QT4=premium (full sand, systematic inspect). QT5=superior (thorough sand, critical inspect, 3+ coats brush/roll). Sheen/QT gate enforced at runtime.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary finish coat application technique. Brush is default for NC trim.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Brush is default per human resolution. Spray available for high-volume NC production. QT5 gloss with brush is achievable — do NOT enforce spray.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen. Constrained by quality tier gate.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Default semi-gloss requires minimum QT4. If user selects QT3, semi-gloss is rejected and satin offered. Gloss is QT5 only.

configuration_dimensions.description: Trim profile complexity. Controls production rate modifiers.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Per Millwork_NC_Paint_Doctrine Section 7.2. Simple=flat/square edge. Standard=ogee/cove. Complex=multi-piece/built-up. Ornate=dentil/egg-and-dart. Applied per trim item — different items in same room may have different profiles.

paintable_items.name: Baseboard
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of baseboard. 1 LF = 1 SF per PCA standard for trim <1 ft width.
paintable_items.notes: Most common trim type. Present in nearly all rooms.

paintable_items.name: Door casing
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of door casing (both sides of each opening). Does NOT include door frame (jamb/stop).
paintable_items.notes: Door casing (exterior trim around opening). Door frame/jamb is SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH.

paintable_items.name: Window casing
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of window casing. Does NOT include window jamb/sill.
paintable_items.notes: Window casing (exterior trim around window opening).

paintable_items.name: Crown molding
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of crown molding at wall-ceiling junction.
paintable_items.notes: Height modifier typically applies — crown is at ceiling height. May need step/extension ladder.

paintable_items.name: Chair rail
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of chair rail at wall mid-height.
paintable_items.notes: Standard height (~32-36 inches from floor). No height modifier.

paintable_items.name: Wainscot cap/rail
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of wainscot cap rail.
paintable_items.notes: Often paired with chair rail. No height modifier.

paintable_items.name: Shadow box / picture frame molding
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of shadow box or picture frame molding on walls.
paintable_items.notes: Decorative wall molding. Profile complexity often 'complex' or 'ornate'.

paintable_items.name: Panel molding
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of panel molding.
paintable_items.notes: Applied wall panel molding. May be simple or complex profile.

paintable_items.name: Picture rail
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear footage of picture rail near ceiling.
paintable_items.notes: Near ceiling height — height modifier may apply. Less common in NC.

variants.notes: Standard brush production at QT3. Satin is the only sheen available at QT3 per gate. Spot sand between coats. Quick glance inspection.
Premium brush production. Semi-gloss typical at QT4. Full 220 grit sand between coats. Systematic inspection at 3 feet.
Superior brush production at QT5 gloss. 3+ coats per FFD 15.10.3. Thorough 220-320 grit sand between coats. Critical inspection at arm's length. Uses ROUND_TRIM_FINISH_3COAT.
Standard spray production. Requires full protection setup. Fastest production method.
Premium spray production. Semi-gloss standard. Full protection.
Superior spray production. QT5 spray uses 2 coats (not 3). Thorough interstage process.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Wall masking LF at trim-to-wall edge
Count of fixtures (outlets/switches) near spray zone requiring covers

protection_zones_required.notes: Runner-style drop cloths along trim perimeter for drip catching. Excluded when floor is subfloor.
Tape + paper masking at trim-to-wall edge for spray method. Also required for brush when walls are SS_PAINTED_* (RC-007).

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Trim and wall commonly different colors/sheens. No edge work — wall is painted AFTER trim package completes. Wall painter cuts into trim edge later. Protection only (masking for spray or when walls SS_PAINTED_*).
Door casing and door frame typically share finish color/sheen. Often painted in same session. Protection setup may be shared.
Crown molding touches finished ceiling. Brush method unlikely to contact ceiling. Spray method may require light masking at crown-ceiling junction.

valid_input_states.notes: This is a finish-only spec. Trim must be primed before finish application. SS_PRIMED_FIELD is the output from SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY applies when factory primer is deemed sufficient.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen dimension. Semi-gloss is trim default (requires QT4+).

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: When walls are finished (SS_PAINTED_*), wall masking at trim-to-wall edge required for BOTH spray and brush methods (RC-007). Spray uses tape + paper. Brush uses tape only.
When walls are unfinished (typical NC), spray method still requires masking at trim-to-wall edge to prevent overspray.
When walls are unfinished and brush method, no wall protection needed — controlled application, no overspray. Typical NC scenario.
Brush method on crown — minimal risk of contacting ceiling surface.
Spray method on crown requires light masking at crown-ceiling junction. Uses same masking approach as wall-adjacent.

site_condition_rules.effect: Floor protection excluded when floor is subfloor.
site_condition_rules.notes: NC often has subfloor during trim painting. Finished/partial floors require drop cloth runners.

site_condition_rules.effect: Height modifier applies for elevated trim (crown molding, high casings, picture rail). H2=1.30 for 9-12ft, H3=1.50 for 13ft+.
site_condition_rules.notes: Per Modifier_Registry. Standard baseboard/casing at floor level has no height modifier.

site_condition_rules.effect: Lead-safe practices for sanding tasks. tested_positive=2.0x, unknown_pre1978=1.5x.
site_condition_rules.notes: Rare in NC (post-1978 construction). Between-coat sanding generates dust requiring containment under RRP.

site_condition_rules.effect: Temperature affects dry times, open time, and leveling. cold_below_50f=1.30x, hot_above_90f=1.15x.
site_condition_rules.notes: Critical for waterborne products with already short working times. NC sites may lack HVAC.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Trim finish typically occurs AFTER ceiling finish and wall prime, BEFORE wall finish in NC sequence. However, spec supports trim finish AFTER walls are painted (requires wall masking per RC-007).
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. Trim-to-wall edge is protection (masking), not cut-in. Wall painter cuts into trim edge during wall finish.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Setup floor protection → Wall masking (if applicable) → Fixture covers (spray only) → Apply coats → Teardown
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Initial prep (light touch-up) → Finish coat 1 → Interstage → Finish coat 2 → [QT5 brush: Interstage → Finish coat 3] → Final inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.companion_spec: SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME handles all heavy prep and primer application. This spec assumes primed substrate.

relationships.notes: Trim package = SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME + SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT. Often painted in same session as door frames (shared material system, same crew). Trim masking for wall painting is SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH responsibility.

sections_used: Surfaces <1 ft width measured as 1 LF

research_corrections.original_claim: Material system selection is mandatory doctrine — QT drives material system
research_corrections.corrected_to: Material systems are suggestions per QT — contractor has discretion on product selection. System identifies proper application characteristics for each product category.

research_corrections.original_claim: Waterborne alkyds have longer open time, benefiting brush/roll
research_corrections.corrected_to: Both Advance (waterborne alkyd) and Emerald Urethane (acrylic-urethane enamel, NOT waterborne alkyd) have SHORT working times — they dry fast. Fast dry is a production benefit but demands proper first-pass technique.

research_corrections.original_claim: Walls at SS_PRIMED_FIELD during trim finish. After trim finish, trim is masked for wall painting.
research_corrections.corrected_to: Spec supports both scenarios: (1) walls primed during trim finish (typical NC), (2) walls already painted (requires wall masking at trim-to-wall edge for both brush and spray). Masking off finished trim for wall painting belongs in the WALL spec.

pending_doctrine_updates.proposed_change: Add note clarifying that QT-driven material systems are recommendations — contractor retains discretion.
Review waterborne alkyd open time claim. Clarify Emerald Urethane classification as acrylic-urethane enamel.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC interior trim finish coat (Spec #9 in Phase 1 catalog). Key features: 9 trim types as separate paintable items (shared with SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME), LF as primary UOM per PCA standard, finish-only Scenario B module structure, 4 material systems as QT-driven recommendations (not mandates per RC-005), sheen/QT gate (satin QT3+, semi-gloss QT4+, gloss QT5 only), profile complexity modifiers (simple/standard/complex/ornate), 2-coat standard with 3+ coats at QT5 brush/roll per FFD 15.10.3, support for trim finish after wall painting (RC-007), product classification correction for Emerald Urethane (RC-006), waterborne application philosophy (apply/tip/walk away per FFD 15.3.1).
